adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders the current `OpenStruct` model without persisting anything (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb:10-13), and there’s a PUT route wired to it (`put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`). On the client, `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` defines a `saveChanges` action that calls `this.get('embedding').update({});`, but `app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/embedding.hbs` never invokes `saveChanges` (only `addHost` and per-host save/delete actions exist). So the finding’s core point—that the PUT/update path is a no-op and currently unused, and the “embedding” wrapper resource exists mainly to give `store.find('embedding')` something to load—is grounded in the diff. This is more of an API/design/maintainability concern than a present functional defect because hosts are managed via `resources :embeddable_hosts` and per-host save/delete, and nothing currently relies on the embedding PUT persisting fields.
